name: settings-window
title: Settings window
description: Settings in one modal window on the native dialog: sections on the left and the chosen one on the right, a list then a section with Back on phones, deep links by section, and Cmd+,.

props.name: open
props.description: Shows the window as a modal dialog.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with false on Esc, the close button or a click on the backdrop.

props.name: sections
props.description: The sections, in the order they list.

props.name: section
props.description: The section on show, controlled. null shows the list step on a narrow screen and the first section on a wide one.

props.name: onSectionChange
props.description: Called when a section is picked, or with null for Back.

props.name: footer
props.description: Under the section list on wide screens and under the list step on narrow ones, such as a version line.

props.name: narrowBelow
props.description: Below this width in px the window fills the screen and works in two steps. Default 720.

props.name: labels
props.description: Visible and spoken text, with English defaults.

a11y.text: It is a native modal dialog, so focus stays inside, Esc closes it and focus goes back to what opened it. In the section list ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home and End move between sections; on a wide screen the pane follows. On a narrow screen focus lands on the first section (or the one you came back from) in the list step and on Back inside a section. useSettingsShortcut opens it on Cmd+, or Ctrl+,.

The dialog is named by its title (an h2). The section list is a nav with aria-current="page" on the open section, and the section is a region named by its h3 title. A badge is read after the section's name. SettingsRow can hand its label and description ids to the control for aria-labelledby and aria-describedby.
The window fades up 8 px over 220 ms when it opens. Under reduced motion it appears at once.
Below narrowBelow (720 px) it fills the screen, keeps clear of the safe areas, and section buttons are 48 px tall; on wide screens 40 px with 44 px rows in the pane.
